title: Sharpen grumpy pass receipt v1
description: Written by a grumpy pass as its last step, under the gitignored <worktree>/.sharpen/grumpy/<branch>/receipts/<skill>.json (<worktree>/.claude/grumpy/ before grumpy 2.15; sdlc 4.21+ still reads receipts there). The sdlc gate chain records a skill gate only from a receipt naming a commit on the branch, and only while the report it names is still on disk (a changed report records with a warning). A record that the work ran, not a security boundary.

report.description: The pass's report file, relative to the folder holding receipts/: <worktree>/.sharpen/grumpy/<branch>/ (or .claude/grumpy/<branch>/ before grumpy 2.15).

report_sha256.description: sha256 of that report when the receipt was written; links the receipt to the evidence, not a security boundary.

executor.description: Which path ran the pass when it wasn't an agent host following the command: oneshot.py writes {host: oneshot, provider, model} (grumpy 2.16.0+). sdlc shows it next to the gate in --status. Absent on an agent host's receipt.

stage.description: fix only: which review the run resolved. Written as receipts/fix-<stage>.json, so one fix run earns one fix gate (grumpy 2.11.0+).
